verdicts.reason: A: the white card now covers almost the whole canvas, so the architectural photo is reduced to thin slivers at the top and right edges and the card looks cropped. The oversized logo competes with the headline, and 'NOW OPEN' floats alone in empty space on the right, cut off from the copy it introduces. B: it keeps the photo-plus-card split, but the logo is blown up and sits directly on the busy photo, competing with the headline. The 'Plan a Visit' button sits above the headline and the 'NOW OPEN' label has dropped below the body text, which scrambles the reading order. It is still the less bad resize because the brand imagery and overall feel survive.
